sections.title: Ask about future plans
sections.content: Use simple questions with *ir a* to ask what someone is going to do.

sections.title: Future-plan questions
rows: What are you going to do?
Where are you going to go?
What are you going to do on Saturday?

items.english: What are you going to do tomorrow?
Are you going to travel on Saturday?
Where are you going to go?

sections.content: Keep the structure together in questions: *¿Qué vas a hacer?* and *¿Vas a viajar?*
